invariants.rationale: The method unconditionally calls methods (extension, etc.) on 'file'.
fileName is passed as a resource name and is always needed for dependency lookup.
file.extension() is chained with .toLowerCase() and .equals(), so should not return null.
The extension string is used to direct branching logic; an empty string would likely lead to an error.
It is likely that the file must exist in order to load its dependencies.
